nodes.title: 呼叫作業系統 connect
body: 指定核准的 IP 與 TCP 連接埠

nodes.title: 開始三向交握
body: 測試端送 SYN
伺服器回 SYN＋ACK

nodes.title: 完成基本交握
body: 作業系統送 ACK
取得連線成功或錯誤結果

nodes.title: 記錄並結束測試
body: 保留方法、時間與系統回報
服務內容依任務另外查核

footer: 合成流程；連線建立與網站功能各有查核結果。

nodes.title: Call the operating system connect interface
body: Specify approved IP and TCP port

nodes.title: Begin the three-way handshake
body: The test endpoint sends SYN
The server responds with SYN+ACK

nodes.title: Complete the basic handshake
body: The operating system sends ACK
Obtain connection success or an error

nodes.title: Record and end the test
body: Retain method, time and system result
Check service content separately as required

footer: Synthetic flow; connection and web function are separate checks.

nodes.title: 送出 TCP SYN
body: 觀察建立連線的起始回應

nodes.title: 收到 SYN＋ACK
body: 符合此方法的開放回應特徵
記錄回覆來源與時間

nodes.title: 以 RST 結束嘗試
body: 不繼續一般交握的最後 ACK
保留實際控制旗標紀錄

nodes.title: 整理工具判讀
body: 此情境按 SYN 方法記 open
方法、回應與後續查核分欄

footer: 典型紙上案例；權限與封包細節依執行環境。

nodes.title: Send TCP SYN
body: Approved source → 192.0.2.20:443
Observe the initial connection response

nodes.title: Receive SYN+ACK
body: An open-response pattern for this method
Record response source and time

nodes.title: End the attempt with RST
body: Do not continue with the usual final ACK
Retain the observed control flags

nodes.title: Record the tool interpretation
body: This SYN example is recorded as open
Separate method, response and follow-up checks

footer: Typical paper example; privileges and details depend on platform.

nodes.title: 對應 UDP 回覆 → open
body: 核對目標連接埠及回覆關係
保留送出的酬載與回應

nodes.title: IPv4 ICMP 3／3 → closed
body: Type 3、Code 3：連接埠無法到達
核對回報來源與原始探測

nodes.title: 特定其他 ICMP 錯誤 → filtered
body: 依工具定義與實際類型判讀
保留完整類型、代碼與來源

nodes.title: 重試後無回覆 → open|filtered
body: 保留開放或過濾的可能
再查查詢格式、政策與服務設定

footer: 四種不同結果並列；Type／Code 例子適用 IPv4。

nodes.title: Corresponding UDP reply → open
body: Match the target port and response
Retain the payload and received message

nodes.title: IPv4 ICMP 3/3 → closed
body: Type 3, Code 3: port unreachable
Check source and the referenced probe

nodes.title: Certain other ICMP errors → filtered
body: Use the tool’s rules and actual message type
Retain type, code and source

nodes.title: No reply after retries → open|filtered
body: Keep open or filtered as alternatives
Review query format, policy and service settings

footer: Alternative outcomes; the type/code example is for IPv4.

nodes.title: 原始觀察
body: 送了什麼、收到什麼、等了多久
來源、目的、協定、埠與時間

nodes.title: 工具判讀
body: Connect／SYN／UDP 各有規則
open、closed、filtered 等狀態

nodes.title: 服務與政策查核
body: 監聽設定、TLS、HTTP 與用途
依任務及授權範圍選擇檢查

nodes.title: 驗收及差異追蹤
body: 比對預期清單、日誌與複測結果
保留版本、速率、等待與重試設定

footer: 每項結論均可追溯；舊觀察保留供比較。

nodes.title: Raw observation
body: What was sent, received and waited for?
Source, destination, protocol, port and time

nodes.title: Tool interpretation
body: Connect, SYN and UDP use their own rules
States such as open, closed and filtered

nodes.title: Service and policy verification
body: Listeners, TLS, HTTP and business purpose
Choose checks within task and authorization

nodes.title: Validation and differences
body: Compare expected inventory, logs and retests
Retain version, rate, timeout and retry settings

footer: Keep conclusions traceable and retain earlier observations.
